spacing.note: No strict base unit; mixes gap and margin. Section rhythm ~78px.

taste.name: Print Flatness Over App Depth
taste.trigger: When deciding how episode, quote, and topic blocks should sit on the page
taste.decision: Gave everything hard 0px corners and zero shadow, dividing cells with a 1px hairline, over the rounded-card-with-drop-shadow surface most podcast/CMS templates ship with
taste.reason: A reader trusts a magazine differently than an app; sharp edges and flat ink say 'this is edited writing', not 'this is a feed to swipe'

taste.name: Three Typefaces as a Signage System
taste.trigger: When one page had to carry a monumental brand name, dense interview prose, and dozens of small meta labels
taste.decision: Assigned each a dedicated typeface — Prata display, Golos Text body, IBM Plex Mono labels — over the economy of one family in several weights
taste.reason: People navigate faster when form encodes function; an all-caps mono tag is read as a label before it is read as words, a Prata line as a title
evidence: no family used outside its role

taste.name: One Dark Room, Then Daylight
taste.trigger: When choosing the site's overall value key
taste.decision: Lit a single dark navy hero with a constellation canvas, then dropped into warm cream for everything below, over committing to one consistent mode top-to-bottom
taste.reason: The dark opener reads as a night sky / title card matching the 'покоритель' frontier theme, and crossing into daylight physically signals 'the reading starts here'
evidence: hero body text shifts to cool #AFC1D2, unused elsewhere

taste.name: Red Kept Scarce
taste.trigger: When a red-accented brand could have washed headers, borders, and section fills in red
taste.decision: Rationed red to rubric dashes, inline links, and the single primary button, leaving all structure in warm neutrals — over spending the brand color for raw visibility
taste.reason: An accent only means 'look here / act here' if it is rare; once red coats backgrounds nothing is emphasized and the page starts to shout
